meta.name: dask
meta.description: Distributed computing for larger-than-RAM pandas/NumPy workflows. Use when you need to scale existing pandas/NumPy code beyond memory or across clusters. Best for parallel file processing, distributed ML, integration with existing pandas code. For out-of-core analytics on single machine use vaex; for in-memory speed use polars.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将超出单机内存的数据分析任务扩展到分布式集群并行处理
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果数据处理量大到单机内存装不下
copy.tagline_en: Scale your pandas/NumPy workflows beyond memory on distributed clusters.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to process datasets too large for a single machine's memory.

howto.what: Claude 会改用 Dask 库：把放不进内存的 pandas/NumPy 运算拆成小块，并行跑在多个核心或多台电脑上，并在表格、数组、文本、自定义任务等组件中选合适的。
howto.when: 当数据量超出内存、需要并行处理多个文件、或想把 pandas/NumPy 代码扩展到多核或集群时触发。

say.text: 我的 100GB CSV 内存装不下，请用 Dask 帮我按类统计。
say.note: Claude 会写出分块读取并统计的 Dask 代码。

say.text: 把这套 pandas 代码改成 Dask，并在 4 台机器上运行。
say.note: Claude 会让这些计算在多台机器上并行完成。

howto.what_en: Claude will write Python code using Dask: it splits pandas/NumPy operations that exceed memory into chunks and runs them in parallel across cores or machines, choosing from DataFrame, Array, Bag, or Futures as appropriate.
howto.when_en: Triggers when data exceeds RAM, multiple files need parallel processing, or existing pandas/NumPy code should scale to multiple cores or a cluster.

say_en.text: My 100GB CSV won't fit in RAM; use Dask to summarize it by category.
say_en.note: Claude will produce Dask code that reads in chunks and aggregates.

say_en.text: Turn this pandas code into Dask and run it on 4 machines.
say_en.note: Claude will run the computation in parallel across machines.

say_en.text: Use Dask to process these JSON logs in parallel and keep status=error records.
say_en.note: Claude will parse the JSON and keep only error entries.
